description: Angular component for configuring SNMP device profile communication settings, including form management, validation, and dynamic control handling.

classes.name: SnmpDeviceProfileCommunicationConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing control value accessor and validator for SNMP communication configuration.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with provided communication configuration data.

methods.name: addCommunicationConfig
methods.description: Adds a new communication configuration form group.

methods.name: removeCommunicationConfig
methods.description: Removes a communication configuration at specified index.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates changes.
